Simple, all-inclusive pricing

Two ways to book.

Most guests choose the per-person all-inclusive plan, stay, all meals, and tea, one simple price. Prefer a whole room? Pick a room type instead.

All-Inclusive · Per Person
₹2,500 / person / day

The simplest way to stay. Everything below is included, you just show up.

  • Comfortable room (shared on twin basis)
  • Breakfast, lunch & dinner, all vegetarian, Garhwali home-style
  • Morning yoga & evening meditation
  • Jungle & village walks with our team
  • Pickup and drop can be arranged at additional cost
